title: DLMF 5.13 Integrals: In ( 5.13.1 ) the integration path is a straight line parallel to the imaginary axis.
summary: DLMF 5.13 Integrals: In ( 5.13.1 ) the integration path is a straight line parallel to the imaginary axis.
body: NIST DLMF section 5.13 (Integrals) says: "In ( 5.13.1 ) the integration path is a straight line parallel to the imaginary axis. For compendia of integrals of gamma functions see Apelblat ( 1983 , pp. 124–127 and 129–130) , Erdélyi et al. ( 1954a , b ) , Gradshteyn and Ryzhik ( 2015 , §6.4) , Oberhettinger ( 1974 , pp. 191–204) , Oberhettinger and Badii ( 1973 , pp. 307–316) , Prudnikov et al. ( 1986b , pp. 57–64) , Prudnikov et al. ( 1992a , pp. 127–130) , and Prudnikov et al. ( 1992b , pp. 113–123) ." Equation 5.13.1 on the page has alt text "{\frac{1}{2\pi i}\int_{c-i\infty}^{c+i\infty}\Gamma\left(s+a\right)\Gamma\left% (b-s\right)z^{-s}\,\mathrm{d}s=\frac{\Gamma\left(a+b\right)z^{a}}{(1+z)^{a+b}}},". Equation 5.13.2 on the page has alt text "{\frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}|\Gamma\left(a+it\right)|^{2}e^{(2b-\pi)% t}\,\mathrm{d}t=\frac{\Gamma\left(2a\right)}{(2\sin b)^{2a}}},". This card records that section's wording and equation alt text. It does not retypeset a formula the alt text did not carry.
